about_the_game:
You are the last Defender, guardian of the ancient Orbital Core, the central source of power around which everything revolves. After centuries of slumber, you have awakened to once again defend it from the onslaught of enemy hordes.

Each new enemy invasion triggers another cycle of defense, and with each battle you become stronger. Can you make it to the end, protect the Core of the Orbit, and destroy all enemies?

Gather resources, unlock dozens of upgrades, change tactics, and step by step approach the final goal in this dynamic incremental game — to break the eternal cycle and save the Core of the Orbit.

⚡ Fast-paced and intense sessions

Short, dynamic battles lasting just a few minutes, where every decision matters. Progress is saved between cycles, allowing you to become stronger step by step and move towards your goal.

🎯 Dodge and attack

Fight waves of geometric enemies using agility, strategy, and the ability to find the perfect moment to counterattack. Each cycle requires new tactics — hone your skills and become unbeatable.

🛠 Numerous improvements

Collect resources and unlock dozens of upgrades: strengthen your weapons, reinforce your shields, develop special abilities, and combine them to create a unique strategy. With each cycle, your arsenal becomes broader and more powerful.

🌌 Final goal

Break through to the Singularity point and escape the endless orbit. Only by overcoming each cycle and improving your abilities can you break the vicious circle and gain true freedom.

In LOOPINITY: Break the Cycle, each cycle is a step towards freedom.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: LOOPINITY: Break the Cycle is a short incremental game that immerses you in a world of endless cycles and geometric chaos. Take control of a rift guardian, fend off waves of enemies, collect valuable resources, and upgrade your abilities. Break the closed orbit and achieve long-awaited freedom.

English*, Ukrainian, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Japanese, French, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
